_readme: Scroll-scrubbed video slot. Put an MP4 you have the rights to in this folder and set src (and optionally poster, caption, credit). For smooth scrubbing, encode with a keyframe on every frame, e.g.: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf scale=1920:-2 -c:v libx264 -g 1 -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p -an -movflags +faststart scrub.mp4
